diagnostics.coverage_notice: These are test records of source capability. A successful sample does not mean full historical coverage.
diagnostics.development_only: Scheduled collection is configured separately; test samples never replace real collection.
diagnostics.policy_scope: Development only: scheduled sample checks. Normal use keeps full new-filing discovery, the 3-month backfill and on-demand 8-year prices.
diagnostics.sample_development_only: Test samples are available in development mode only.
maintenance.busy: A backup, restore or cleanup is running; try again later
probe.cooldown: The source is cooling down; the task will verify after waiting.
probe.failed: Source check failed ({{error}}); existing data is kept.
probe.fixture_done: 8 synthetic test checkpoints committed; not market or Insider data.
probe.market_empty: {{ticker}} returned no daily bars; that does not mean the security does not exist or did not trade.
probe.market_note: Collected records, not the provider's raw HTTP; split-only basis and daily completeness are not verified yet.
probe.market_ok: {{ticker}}: {{count}} daily bars sampled; splits, dividends and full coverage are not verified yet.
probe.sec_http: SEC returned HTTP {{status}}; the source gap is recorded.
probe.sec_not_atom: The SEC response is not the expected Atom document.
probe.sec_ok: Read {{count}} SEC discovery entries; no transaction XML downloaded yet, and this says nothing about historical coverage.
probe.sec_too_large: The SEC sample exceeds the 5 MiB test budget.
storage.disk_low: Less than 10 GiB free; new collection stopped.
storage.estimate_scope: Filing sizes come from source records, backups from their manifests (the shared object pool is estimated from the latest manifest) and the database from PostgreSQL; the exact check measures real disk use. Backup estimates assume no reuse of the object pool; a restore recomputes from the chosen manifest
storage.hash_mismatch: Source object hash mismatch; check the storage.
storage.object_size: Source objects must be 1 byte to 128 MiB; split larger indexes into ranges.
storage.reference_mismatch: The source reference does not match the saved filing, so no evidence is published.
ui.data.policy_tip.backup: Back up the database and filings every Sunday at 03:30 ET with a restore check; the last two are kept.
ui.data.policy_tip.maintenance: Delete expired price caches and refetchable files.
ui.data.policy_tip.market: Update visible market quotes and backfill and update long-term daily prices after each close.
ui.data.policy_tip.sec: Check SEC for new Form 3/4/5 filings (every 60 seconds during the trading day).
ui.diagnostics.intro: For development checks only (SAMPLE_ONLY): probes never become coverage or research results.
ui.health.command.backup_stale: Run in the project folder to make a backup now.
ui.health.command.database: Run in the project folder to see what is running.
ui.health.command.worker_offline: Run in the project folder to start the services.
ui.index_lists.title: Index lists
ui.index_lists.failed: Last attempt failed: {{reason}}. The previous list stays in use and is retried automatically.
ui.index_lists.note: Unofficial copies: the S&P 500 list from GitHub datasets (with GICS sectors and sub-industries), the Nasdaq 100 table from Wikipedia (with ICB industries). Used for the SPX/NDX marks, the index filters and the sector of a stock.
ui.data.political.title: Government transaction disclosures
ui.data.political.scope: House and Senate periodic transaction reports from January 1, 2025; executive branch OGE 278-T reports from January 20, 2025. Original files remain available, including reports awaiting parsing. Transactions count linked amendments once; unresolved amendments await review.
ui.data.political.treasury_exemption: U.S. Treasury transactions may be exempt from reporting. Disclosures do not cover every trade; any voluntarily reported entries are retained.
